D.t: Cory Booker leads by 20.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 737,970 votes; a one point swing is about 17,860 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +11.6 and D +30.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Essex, a projected net 176,092 votes; Hudson, a projected net 101,895 votes; Middlesex, a projected net 83,394 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Cory Booker runs furthest behind in Gloucester, Cape May, Burlington. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 62% of voters, 50 to 47, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.08 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 56% of voters, 59 to 38, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.78 points; College graduates, 52% of voters, 61 to 37, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.62 points.
